provenance.capture_method: Bounded Playwright capture with robots, DNS, SSRF, route, runtime, byte, concurrency, and delay controls
provenance.adjudication_method: Codex pixel inspection of viewport, mobile, and full-page contact sheets plus independent collection review
provenance.redistribution_boundary: Derived observations and source URLs only; third-party screenshots remain operator-local

retrieval_policy.dominance_guard: Use at most one developer-tool or design-system anchor unless the target is itself a developer tool or design system

context_only_domains.nextjs.org: Documentation IA or anti-template comparison only; generic monochrome grid and consent obstruction prevent positive admission.
context_only_domains.ui.shadcn.com: Component anatomy and documentation taxonomy only; literal defaults conflict with the anti-template doctrine.
context_only_domains.vercel.com: Content-insensitive blank-space and template-aesthetic anti-example only.
context_only_domains.www.typewolf.com: Typography taxonomy metadata only; low contrast, dated composition, and absent mobile evidence prevent positive admission.

collection_limits: Developer tools and design systems remain overrepresented.
Consumer hardware, fashion, travel, health, entertainment, and consumer-finance coverage remains weak.
Captured pages are time-bound observations, not permanent statements about a source brand.
Visual approval does not establish accessibility, runtime behavior, legal rights, conversion performance, or business outcomes.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Astro makes the technical product feel authored through a cosmic illustration system while keeping code and documentation primary.
reference_index.risk: Decoration can overpower information if transferred to sober enterprise work.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Base Web treats navigation density as the product, exposing the system without wrapping it in marketing theatre.
reference_index.risk: Useful as an information scaffold, not as a distinctive visual identity.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: The GOV.UK Design System removes ornamental hierarchy and lets task labels, links, and examples carry the entire experience.
reference_index.risk: Institutional austerity should not be mistaken for a universal brand voice.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: USWDS layers orientation, implementation guidance, and policy context without collapsing every reader into one documentation path.
reference_index.risk: Density is appropriate to policy documentation but excessive for simple product onboarding.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Fluent 2 uses expressive color and layered geometry as orientation devices around a disciplined enterprise documentation frame.
reference_index.risk: Microsoft-specific geometry and color relationships are identity assets, not generic tokens.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Zendesk Garden carries one botanical metaphor through illustration and language without weakening component-documentation utility.
reference_index.risk: A metaphor becomes costume when it is not native to the target brand.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Linear makes real product surfaces, restrained type, and one indigo accent perform the brand promise instead of illustrating it abstractly.
reference_index.risk: Linear-like monochrome SaaS is heavily imitated and becomes generic without target-specific product truth.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Material 3 explains an adaptive system by showing components in varied shapes, scales, and color roles rather than presenting tokens alone.
reference_index.risk: Material styling is a strong authored system and should not silently replace a target system.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Motion turns live behavior into the documentation medium, so examples demonstrate timing and feel before prose explains APIs.
reference_index.risk: Static imitation misses the reference's core value; motion must remain functional and reduced-motion safe.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Ncase uses character, illustration, and interaction as explanatory structure rather than decoration around conventional articles.
reference_index.risk: The approach depends on original illustration and interaction; generic mascots cannot substitute.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Next.js preserves one monochrome system across promotion, dense docs, and ecosystem proof while changing hierarchy for each task.
reference_index.risk: Black-and-white developer aesthetics are common and need target-specific structure to avoid template sameness.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: PostHog combines candid pricing and technical density with an unmistakable illustration voice, letting personality coexist with product proof.
reference_index.risk: Quirk becomes noise in regulated or high-trust contexts.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: The Pudding lets each story's subject determine its visual treatment while a restrained editorial index keeps the collection coherent.
reference_index.risk: The variety is supported by bespoke reporting and cannot be reproduced as arbitrary decorative variation.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Raycast turns command surfaces and extensions into luminous product objects, creating premium depth without hiding the software interaction model.
reference_index.risk: Glass, glow, and depth effects become empty spectacle without real product surfaces.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Stripe pairs an owned iridescent field with real code and numerate detail, speaking to developers and financial buyers on the same page.
reference_index.risk: Stripe-like gradients and diagonal geometry are overcopied and fail when detached from technical substance.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Shadcn keeps live component examples, source-oriented installation, and category navigation in one calm documentation frame.
reference_index.risk: Its visual language is a widespread default; use the information architecture, not the unmodified component aesthetic.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Vercel makes hairlines, strict geometry, and explanatory diagrams one system, so restrained color becomes meaningful.
reference_index.risk: Vercel-like black, white, grids, and bento layouts are common AI-design clichés when copied without product logic.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Cooper Hewitt lets collection objects form the hero composition, using bold condensed labels and a black utility frame to organize visual abundance.
reference_index.risk: The structure depends on excellent object photography and disciplined crop direction.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: GOV.UK makes search, task nouns, and predictable links the visual system, minimizing interpretation cost for consequential actions.
reference_index.risk: Visual austerity is appropriate to public service but not proof that every commercial surface should be austere.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Noema shifts between a spacious single-feature opening, a dense topic archive, and quiet subscription commerce while preserving one editorial hierarchy.
reference_index.risk: Large editorial whitespace and serif hierarchy do not transfer directly to task-dense product UI.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Pentagram lets project imagery set rhythm and color while typography and chrome retreat to a consistent editorial index.
reference_index.risk: The restraint succeeds because the imagery is exceptional; weak assets leave the system empty.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Radix separates primitives, themes, and icons into distinct visual propositions while preserving a precise, low-noise technical voice.
reference_index.risk: Quiet precision can become anonymous without a clear product taxonomy.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Shopify connects an immediate start action to merchant imagery, product surfaces, and scaled business proof without separating aspiration from setup.
reference_index.risk: Broad proof density can overwhelm narrower products that lack Shopify's category breadth.

reference_index.distinctive_choice: Typewolf makes typography itself the navigation and evidence layer, pairing specimens with enough taxonomy to support comparison.
reference_index.risk: Font specimens and licensing context are source-specific; visual variety cannot replace functional hierarchy.
